text:
maria: heads up — saw a spike of 413s on /v1/embeddings this morning after the routing change.
kevin: logs?
maria: snippet: ```ERROR 413 payload too large: vectors[0] len=384 vs route expects 768```
kevin: hmm, that looks like a dimension mismatch hit routed to a shard expecting a different model variant. we dropped mixed-dim acceptance in routing v2 to simplify kernels.
sunil: proposal: add a lightweight per-request header `X-Embed-Dim` and a preflight behavior so router can short-circuit and either route correctly or return a clear error before payload upload.
anne: is a new endpoint necessary? can we piggyback on OPTIONS or a tiny `POST /v1/embeds/preflight`? internal clients only.
sunil: either works. preflight POST can return JSON: ```{"route":"embed-768-us-east-1","accepts":true,"est_batch_ms":12}``` — quick and explicit.
kevin: agree on explicit. also we need telemetry first. add metrics: `embed.dim_mismatch.rejects`, `embed.batch.utilization`, and `embed.route_mismatch.rate`.
maria: for the Console: show per-route dim distribution, a small histogram and a sample of rejected requests with the suggested fix copy. makes debugging for customers much faster.
kevin: also change API error to be actionable. sample error: ```409 EMBED_DIM_MISMATCH: all vectors in request must have the same dim. Try splitting payloads or set X-Embed-Dim header. docs: /docs/embeds#dims```
anne: quota impact: some customers hit the per-request byte cap when they try mixing small+large vectors in the same payload. maybe add a soft-warning header `X-Embed-Bytes-Estimate` or increase soft cap for a rollout window.
sunil: implementation plan I propose: 1) instrument metrics and emit error with new code E_EMBED_DIM_MISMATCH (EOD), 2) add optional `X-Embed-Dim` preflight support (next 2 days), 3) Console dashboard tile for dim distribution and rejects (next week), 4) canary routing change with header-first routing, 5) full rollout.
maria: timeline ok for support and SRE? we'll need a diagnostic snippet for customers to run.
kevin: I'll push a small PR with runtime metric hooks and error strings: github.com/redwood/eng-runtime/pull/489. Deploy once green to canary.
maria: I'll author the Console tile copy and include examples.
console-bot: issue created: CON-1123 "Embeds: dim distribution tile + reject samples" (assigned to maria).
deploy-bot: deploy started: eng-runtime/embed-routing-v2 -> canary (3 hosts).
sunil: note: keep backward compatibility — header optional, default behavior unchanged if header absent. we should not drop mixed-dim requests without explicit config until dashboard in place.
kevin: agreed. but runtime will emit `embed.dim_mismatch.rejects` so we can measure before making it strict.
maria: thanks team. ping me when canary is up and when we have first metric counts so I can prep a short customer note. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy success: eng-runtime/embed-routing-v2 canary up (3 hosts)
kevin: nice. i'll watch `embed.batch.utilization` and `embed.dim_mismatch.rejects` for the next 24h and follow up with numbers.
maria: perfect — will draft the API error copy and docs PR after we see metric baseline.
